name: VideoEditorCore
summary: Timeline video editor: preview and export share one AVFoundation composition.
description:
Timeline-based multi-clip video editor (trim, split, stickers, text, color filters,
transitions, audio) with 9:16 MP4 export. The editing screen, the engine and the result
all live here; the preview draws the same composition the export renders, so what you see
is what you get. A license key from https://infinive.dev is required to open the editor.
